system.description:
"Damn. It's blazing in here. Fui! Turn on the vents!" After a long days work, Kuro rocked back in his chair, shutting his eyes. He and the other shinobi in his battalion were laying low and catching some rest after completing their mission "I'm on it, I'm on it." As the cool air began to rush in, Kuro began to slowly doze off. That is, until the air begin to gradually become warmer and warmer. "Hey what the hell?!" The sounds of clashing kunai and punches being thrown could be heard echoing through the room, accompanied by pained groans and profanities. Kuro opened his eyes to see two of his men fighting each other, one pressing a kunai at the other's chest, seemingly against his will. "Fui! Don’t! -" As the shinobi fell to the ground, Fui stood in confusion, but just as quickly as he began to question what just happened, smoke emanates from his mouth, eyes, and nose, taking the form of an unknown Shinobi from the Land of Fire. The shinobi wraps his legs around Fui, taking him down in one fell swoop. As Kuro begins to slowly reach for his blade, a gust of smoke blows it out of his reach, and in a burst of wind, the Shinobi appears and presses a kunai to his throat. The Shinobi reaches for a radio link on his jacket. "Jōki, I'm in."

- Jōki Hatake The Long Road, Ch. 42 excerpt.

Born of Ash

The Iburi Clan is a seclusive clan scattered all throughout the Land of Fire. Members of this clan possess a powerful Kekkei Genkai that allows them to transform themselves into smoke. In the past, this versatile ability proved to be a curse rather than a blessing, as it could not be controlled, causing some of the Iburi to be dispersed and killed in the winds. This burden, however, was resolved by one of the Leaf's legendary Sannin, granting the later generations mastery over their power.

Iburi Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Con Speed: 30 feet. Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Survival Passive Affinity: You begin with the Fire release affinity.

Iburi Techniques: The Iburi Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Iburi Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Smoke Free Zone: Whenever you would enter an area obscured by smoke, mist or even a gas that is naturally occurring and not jutsu based, you can passively dispel it as your travel through, clearing your space of the obscuring haze.

Iburi Features

Smoke Style

1st Level Clan Feature

In the past, the instability and unpredictability of the Iburi’s kekkei genkai made it impossible to impossible to incorporate any basic shinobi arts into the technique. However, that was then, and this is now. Thanks to a stabilizing cure, generations of Iburi have been able to thrive and utilize the clans new unique fighting style known as the Smoke Style fighting stance.

You can enter the Smoke Style Chakra stance as a bonus action. When you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns. While in this stance, you can benefit from either a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu stance and increase your movement speed by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th levels.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Dancing Cinder. You release small cinders around your feet, which generates a smoky haze around them, propelling your movements. While in this stance variant, you gain the following benefits:

Cinder Bow. You gain access to a special weapon called a Cinder Bow, which is formed entirely of special smoke originating from your bloodline, in a design of your choice. This weapon has the statistics of a Long Bow, with a d12 damage die, deals fire damage, and can use your Hijutsu Flexibility to calculate its attack and damage rolls. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon and can dismiss it at no action cost. Reforming it costs a bonus action.

Once per turn, if your attack with this weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC they gain a rank of Dazzled.

Once per round, you can take an attack of opportunity without spending your reaction.

Creatures provoke attack of opportunities from you when moving within 10 feet of you.

Fume Brawler. You release small cinders around your hands, as you prepare to engage in melee combat. While in this stance variant, you gain the following benefits:

Smoke Chains. You gain access to a special weapon called Smoke Chains, which is formed entirely of special smoke originating from your bloodline, in a design of your choice. This weapon has the statistics of a Whip, with a d10 damage die, deals fire damage, and can use your Hijutsu Flexibility to calculate its attack and damage rolls. You cannot be disarmed of this weapon and can dismiss it at no action cost. Reforming it costs a bonus action.

Once per turn, if your attack with this weapon is 5 or higher than the targets AC they gain a rank of Envenomed.

Once per round, you can take the Dash or Disengage actions at no action cost on your turn.

As part of casting a jutsu with the Fire Release keywords or passing a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, you can select one space you can see within 15 feet of you that can hold you, as you transform into a cloud of smoke and swiftly move to that space. Attacks of opportunity against this movement are at disadvantage.

Will-O-Wisps

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your clans Kekkei Genkai grants you unparalleled control over your bodies physical make up and smoke created by fire. Your clan has fostered a plethora of ways to augment their techniques utilizing this special technique and control called Will-O-Wisps.

You begin with 2 Will-O-Wisps of your choice, gaining an additional Will-O-Wisp at 7th and 15th levels. If a Will-O-Wisp forces a saving throw, use your highest jutsu saving throw to resolve its effect.

Ashen Simplicity

Your clans unique affinity to fire, grants its progeny the opportunity to learn such jutsu at a faster rate than others. When creating or learning jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, reduce the time it takes to complete the task by half.

Ashen Resilience

Due to your bodies loose concept of stability, particles that would normally harm others, have a lessened effect on you. You gain a rank of mastery to saving throws made to resist effects that originate from a cloud, gas or smoke. This bonus also extends to jutsu or effects that have the Inhaled keyword. Beginning at 11th level, this instead becomes 2 ranks of Mastery.

Smoke Haze

Fire gives birth to smoke. Smoke gives birth to hazards. When you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword that requires an attack, you can, once per turn, cause your flames to instead be overcome with a gout of black and gray smoke. All creatures within 5 feet of the original target(s), must make a Dexterity saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Dazzled. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th.

Soot Lung

Fire gives birth to smoke. Smoke gives birth to hazards. When you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword that would inflict ranks of Burned, you cause your flames to instead be overcome with a gout of gray and white smoke. All affected creature that would gain ranks of Burned can instead gain an equal number of ranks of Envenomed. Creatures resistant or immune to Poison damage do not have advantage on saving throws to resist ranks of Envenomed granted by this feature.

The Unburned

Your body radiates a soft but apparent heat, that increases in intensity to match opposing sources of heat that would harm you, making you more tolerant of extreme circumstances. You gain resistance to fire damage and make checks to resist harmful effects from extreme heat at advantage. Starting at 7th level, you can attempt to siphon the scorching heat from an allied creature, treating their burns. As a bonus action, while you are within 15 feet of an allied creature that has ranks of Burn, you can attempt an ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier vs the DC to end the Burned condition (Either the condition or the Save DC, whichever is lower). Beginning at 11th level, you gain immunity to the Burned condition and checks you make to end another creatures burned condition gain a rank of Master to the result. Beginning at 15th level, checks you make to end another creatures burned condition gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the result.

Smoke Burst

You are able to enhance your Smoke Style, granting them enhanced effects based on the stance variant.

Punishing Smog.

Attacks made with Cinder Bow gain a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.

You can target a point with an attack you make with Cinder Bow, instead of a creature, when you do, you fill a 10-foot cube, centered on the point with a thick cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the vision of all creatures within the smoke, and creatures outside the cloud cannot see inside the smoke. This cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Incapacitating Smoke.

The Smoke Chain now has Reach 3, gains the Special property as if it were a Battle Wire.

When you attempt to Trip a creature with your Smoke Chain you can instead choose to attempt to trip all creatures within 5 feet of them comparing your trip result vs each creatures contested result. On a success, they take your [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage]

Aberration of Smoke

7th Level Clan Feature

The curse of your clan, is slowly becoming your blessing. As an Action, you can convert your entire body into smoke and ash, for 1 minute. While in this transformed state, you gain a 20-foot fly speed, and can fit through any cracks or holes that smoke or mist could reasonably fit through. You can end this state at no action cost when you are in a space that can hold you. If you are trapped in a space and this transformation would end, you take 4d6 bludgeoning damage, each turn you cannot return to your normal form.

Additionally, by while in this state, you are resistant to all damage, but have vulnerability to wind damage, but you cannot cast jutsu that requires hand signs or you to physically interact with another creatures, such as a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu.

Once you use this feature to transform, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed.

Ashen Monarch

11th Level Clan Feature

Beyond just your own, you are now capable of controlling any smoke, gas, haze or cloud, by mixing particles of your ashen chakra into it.

As a reaction to entering, or beginning your turn within an effect described as a cloud, gas, haze or smoke, you can make a Ninshou check using your Hijutsu Flexibility score to calculate its results vs the effects Jutsu save DC. If the effect does not have a Jutsu save DC, then instead, use the Standard Level DC of the effect.

On a success, you take control of the area, able to reshape it or move it as a bonus action on your turn. You also gain immunity to its effects. When you command it as a bonus action, you can either move it 20-feet into, using its center most space as the space that moves, or reshape it into a 20-Foot Radius sphere. Apply its effects using your highest jutsu save DC to calculate its Saves or effects. The casting creature loses concentration, and you begin concentration, but at no chakra cost, for up to 1 minute.

Black Lung

15th Level Clan Feature

You can control the smoke your body and jutsu produces to such a degree, that you can even cause it to coat the lungs of your foes, choking them from the inside.

As an Action, you must select a point you can see within 60 feet of you, or as a reaction select a cloud, gas, mist or fog that you are in control of.

If you spend an action selecting a point, you generate a 20-foot radius cloud of black smoke, centered on the chosen point, for the next minute. If you spent your reaction selecting a cloud, gas, mis or fog that you control, your transform it into a cloud of thick black smoke, but in the same shape.

Creatures of your choice that are inside or entering the cloud treat the area as obscured and difficult terrain. Yourself and allies you can see are not hindered by your own cloud. Creatures of your choice who begin or end their turn in the cloud or enter it for the first time on a turn, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Exhaustion, as they begin hacking and wheezing, finding it difficult to breathe.

As a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can move the select point, up to 30 feet into a space you can see. This Cloud can be suspended midair and does not need to settle on the ground.

Creatures that gained ranks of Exhaustion as a result of this feature, that spend at least 1 minute outside of this cloud, loses all ranks of the inflicted Exhaustion.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.
